question: Delay time getter with sync on: min/max
answer: With DL_TIME_UNIT synced, DL_TIME stores an integer note count in field 0 (slot 8): count = round(1 + 11u), min 1 (u=0) max 12 (u=1) (u .1->2, .25->4, .5->7, .75->9); the unit factor goes to field 4 (slot 40) and the free time in ms is kept in field 5 (slot 52, 500 for INIT). Free (unsynced) DL_TIME table runs 5 ms (u=0) to ~2900 ms. Same count law for units 5, 7, 10, 16
